title: Symbol-U API Reference
content:
Symbol-U REST API endpoints:

**Authentication:**
All requests require Bearer token in Authorization header.
```
Authorization: Bearer sk-xxxx
```

**Core Endpoints:**

`POST /api/chat`
Send a message and receive AI response.
```json
{
  "message": "string",
  "tier": "consumer|power_user|admin",
  "provider": "anthropic|google",
  "history": [{"role": "user|assistant", "content": "string"}]
}
```

`POST /api/dilchat/analyze`
Analyze text with full Symbol-U pipeline.
```json
{
  "text": "string",
  "domain": "string"
}
```

`POST /api/session/start`
Start a new conversation session.
```json
{
  "domain": "string",
  "user_id": "string"
}
```

`GET /api/session/{id}/summary`
Get session analytics and summary.

`GET /api/chat/usage`
Get token usage statistics.

**Rate Limits:**
- Starter: 60 requests/minute
- Professional: 300 requests/minute
- Enterprise: Custom

**Error Codes:**
- 400: Bad request
- 401: Unauthorized
- 429: Rate limited
- 500: Internal error
